reader_summary.headline: I discovered Coifin earlier this year when I asked Twitter for the best Bloomberg alternative.
reader_summary.overview: I discovered Coifin earlier this year when I asked Twitter for the best Bloomberg alternative, and the overwhelming winner was an intriguing new product called Coifin. Coiffin is a web-based platform that lets you analyze stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, and other assets all in one place. I now use it daily to track what's going on in the market, and I think if you try it, you will too.

key_points.text: Coifin has tons of high-quality data, powerful functionality, and a nice, clean interface.

thesis: The episode introduces the guests Brad Gerstner and Rich Barton, highlighting their history of meeting in 1999 while working on an online travel deal that eventually led to Expedia's acquisition of NLG. The conversation also touches on their immediate strategic connection, their shared curiosity about life beyond business, and the early realization that transactional businesses would migrate to the internet.
